rationale: The assistant correctly explained 4C as a water supply fault and ordered the checks sensibly: household pressure, tap and hose, then isolating and cleaning the inlet mesh. That led to the fix. It also gave safe isolation steps and held back the inlet valve and engineer until simpler causes were ruled out. Minor weaknesses: it confidently explained the buzz as the valve straining against a blocked inlet, which is a plausible but unverified claim. It also said the machine 'has filled more slowly over recent weeks', which the customer never said, though it was phrased as conditional ('especially if').
